sources.fact: Planning application dataset currently shows 100,627 applications from 6 providers; collector/new-data dates are September 2025 and origin is MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
Planning application status reference dataset currently reports 0 entries/providers and is MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
Planning decision type reference dataset currently reports 0 entries/providers and is MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
Planning application type has 41 reference types from 1 provider, with latest collection in September 2025; it is not an LPA case register.
Planning application log currently reports 0 records/providers, so absence cannot be used as evidence of no planning-history event.
Planning application condition dataset has 5,305 conditions from 1 provider; collector ran 26 July 2026 but source origin remains MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
LPA boundary dataset contains 337 authorities and can help identify responsible authority, but LPA boundary does not identify a specific planning case.
Planning Data API accepts WGS84 polygon geometry with intersects relation and recommends bulk spatial intersections for large portfolios.
Example planning-application entities can contain an exact reference, address, decision/status and a point while geometry is blank.
Constraint datasets such as Article 4 areas have wider current provider coverage than the experimental planning-application feed and must remain separate from case evidence.
Local-plan dataset is useful for plan status/linkage but its current origin also includes MHCLG-created data pending authoritative replacement.
Application records can carry explicit Withdrawn status/decision values; status semantics must be read from the exact bound record rather than inferred from point proximity.

examples.result: Planning Data is used as discovery/API evidence, not as a replacement for LBBD Public Access when exact authoritative case verification is required.
A planning-application point is not treated as the application red-line polygon or HMLR parcel.
Blank geometry does not trigger a synthetic buffer or nearest-parcel snap.
Final Decision or Granted values are accepted only on the exact reference/site record and then cross-checked against the LPA register where available.
Dataset coverage of six providers means absence is not evidence that no application exists in another authority.
Zero-entry status/decision reference datasets are not used to claim exhaustive status vocabularies.
Current constraint polygons can be spatially intersected, but this does not manufacture planning-application geometry.
No candidate promotion occurs without exact application/site/title relation and authoritative current decision evidence.
